title: 💎 Premium is here! (v1.1.0)
message: A big update with Premium, update alerts and a smoother game. Thank you for driving with us!
points: 💎 NEW: Premium — pay once, keep it forever. No ads ever, every train and every feature unlocked.
🎁 Scratch the secret card on the Premium page to reveal a special 1-hour price!
🔔 Update alerts — you'll now see what's new in every version right here.
🎮 More games by DevDuo — tap the new button on the home screen to find our other train games.
✨ Smoother driving, faster menus and better performance.

title: 🚆 Welcome to Train Driver India! (v1.0.0)
message: Drive trains across India — plan your route, build your train and handle every part of the job.
points: 🗺️ Plan any route with stops, loco reversal and banker engines
🚦 Real Indian signals — red, yellow, double yellow and green
🔀 Crossings and overtakes at loop stations
📢 Station announcements in English, Hindi and your language
🌄 10+ landscapes, live weather, day and night
